Coming next

Cybercab — Our Next Big Move

The Tesla Cybercab is Tesla’s purpose-built driverless robotaxi — a two-seat vehicle designed from the ground up for autonomous ride-hailing, with no steering wheel and no pedals. It is in production at Gigafactory Texas and has been carrying paying riders in Austin since September 2026.

2 seats

A cabin built for riders, not drivers.

No wheel, no pedals

Fully driverless by design — nothing to steer, nothing to press.

Butterfly doors

Wide-opening doors for easy entry and exit at the curb.

~293 miles of range

Built for a full day of city service between charges.

Camera-based autonomy

Tesla Vision cameras handle the navigation and the driving.

Wireless charging

Inductive charging — no plug, no attendant, the vehicle charges itself.

Prime Fleet Leasing has registered its interest in Tesla’s robotaxi fleet program for the Dallas region, and we are preparing our fleet operations — charging, cleaning, maintenance and rider support — for autonomous vehicles, so we’re ready as the program opens to fleet operators.

How riding works

1 · Get the app

Download the Tesla Robotaxi app and sign in with a Tesla account.

2 · Enter your destination

Set a destination inside the service area — live today in cities including Austin, Dallas and Houston.

3 · Confirm the ride

See the fare estimate and arrival time, then confirm the ride.

4 · Meet your vehicle

Check the plate shown in the app, get in, buckle up and tap Start Ride.

5 · Ride & step out

Set climate and music during the ride. At arrival, just step out — payment and receipt live in the app.

Lease structures compared

Closed-End (Walk-Away)Open-End (TRAC)
End of termReturn the vehicle; excess wear/mileage charges may applyYou share in resale gain/loss; often a purchase option at market value
Best forPredictable budgets, lower mileage, image-conscious fleetsHigh-mileage, work trucks & vans, longer service life
MileageSet allowance (10k–25k/yr) with per-mile overageNo mileage penalty — value settled at resale

About us

Prime Fleet Leasing LLC

Prime Fleet Leasing LLC is a Texas-based fleet leasing and management company helping small and mid-size businesses put reliable, late-model vehicles on the road — without the capital outlay and administrative burden of owning them.

From a single sales sedan to a fifty-unit service fleet, we source, finance, upfit, maintain and eventually remarket your vehicles under one master agreement and one monthly invoice. Our customers are contractors, delivery and logistics operators, field-service companies and corporate sales teams who would rather spend their cash on growth than on depreciating metal.

Tell us where your drivers are based and we’ll structure delivery, maintenance and fuel support around them.

Frequently asked questions

What’s the minimum fleet size?

One vehicle. Many customers start with 2–5 units and grow. Volume pricing improves at 10+ units.

Can I lease used vehicles?

Yes — late-model, low-mileage used units may be available on shorter terms. Ask us to compare new and used options for your fleet.

What credit do I need?

We work with established businesses (2+ years, business credit history) and, with a personal guaranty, newer companies. Decisions are typically made within one business day.

What happens at the end of the lease?

On a closed-end lease you simply return the vehicle. On open-end/TRAC structures you may purchase at market value or let us remarket it and settle the difference.

Do you deliver outside Texas?

Yes — we deliver across the continental U.S. and support drivers nationally through our maintenance and fuel networks.

Can vehicles be wrapped with our branding?

Absolutely. Wraps and graphics are coordinated before delivery and can be rolled into the lease payment.
